items.title: Hackers Hide Vasilek Backdoor Inside VMware Tools to Target Medical Organizations
items.description: Hackers concealed the Vasilek backdoor inside an existing VMware Tools installation during a prolonged intrusion at a medical organization. The attackers maintained access for approximately two years, exposing sensitive medical information while leaving systems operational rather than launching a destructive attack. The earliest evidence dates to early 2024. Investigators found signs of remote…

items.title: EY Data Breach Exposes Goldman Sachs and Man Group Clients’ Data
items.description: Ernst & Young (EY) has warned that a cyber breach exposed personal and financial information belonging to individuals linked to Goldman Sachs and Man Group. items.title: Personal Information for Over 1 Million People Stolen in a Cyberattack on Arizona’s Court System
items.description: The Arizona Supreme Court said the information was copied for people dating back as far as 30 years. The post Personal Information for Over 1 Million People Stolen in a Cyberattack on Arizona’s Court System appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Critical Healthcare Systems Aren't Quantum-Ready
items.description: A study of 2.5 million devices across 50 healthcare organization suggests the sector has a long way to go in getting ready for the post-quantum cryptography era.
